dedupe_keys.name: hcp morocco rgph 2014 public use microdata 10 household and individual sample with dwelling water sanitation waste electricity cooking fuel and distance to paved road variables stata spss text

description: Morocco's Haut-Commissariat au Plan publishes an anonymised public use microdata file from the 2014 General Population and Housing Census. It is a 10% systematic sample of households with all their members, excluding nomads, homeless people and the population counted separately, in household and individual files in Stata, SPSS and text formats, with Arabic and French documentation. The household file describes the dwelling (type, wall, roof and floor materials, age, rooms, tenure) and its services: lighting mode, water supply mode, distance and time to the water point, wastewater disposal, household waste disposal, cooking fuels, fixed and mobile phone and internet, vehicles, and distance to the nearest paved road in kilometres. Records carry region, province and urban or rural codes and a weight. Coverage is national; the documentation gives the census reference date as 1 September 2014 and states that the sample is representative at national, regional and provincial level. Format and access: free downloads from the HCP site without registration; aggregated indicators by commune are in the RGPH 2014 table site, and the 2024 census results are in a dashboard. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: identifying values are masked, so a few records carry a hidden region; no commune code in the microdata. Simulation uses: provincial service access for water, sanitation, waste and electricity models, road access distance for accessibility studies, and dwelling materials for exposure. Related records: the Ghana 2021 census microdata sample and the Algeria RGPH 2008 urban network.
